lines: In the middle of the fight against Clearー
Listen to me, Yukikaze! I have something to tell you!
What is it!? If you try to stand in the way again like earlier I won't listen!!
Yukikaze said, running out of patience.
Clear was strong. Even with four of us, it was all we could do to slow her down.
That's not it. I realized why I wanted to help her. It's because she's being controlled.
When she had been playing with me, Clear had been innocent and kind-hearted, like a child.
But then why was a girl like her after Asagi-sensei?
Yeah. Just before she started acting strangely, the device on her head had an odd reaction.
I don't have conclusive proof, but I'm sure someone is giving her orders.
Perhaps that was what she had been talking about earlier.
When I had asked Clear if she had contacted her parents, she had shown no sign of having done so...
...But in spite of that, she had replied that it was fine because she had talked to them just earlier.
A-And!? What are you trying to say!?
It's obvious. I want to save her.
Yukikaze was speechless, still on full alert with her lightning guns raised.

W-Wait, Fuma!? Even if you say thatー
that girl is ridiculously strong!!
All of our attacks will be blocked, just like before... Even if you say "I'll save her," it's...
It'll be fine. It's just that your earlier attack wasn't properly coordinated.
With Hebiko's, Yukikaze's, and your abilities, if we think and act properly, it's sure to go well!!
Fuma-chan. Do you have some kind of idea?
Of course. Give your spot-on orders, as always♪
With a face of determination, Shikanosuke also nodded affirmatively together with Hebiko.

Thank youー
Yukikaze, what about you?
I...  w-well, if you insist... then I'll listen to you...
But if you give some weird orders, I'll make you pay for it!!
Yeah. Just leave it to me!!
We briefly discussed our plan and then faced Clear, who was ready for battle.
...K I L L... T A I M A N I N...
Clear closed the distance, with no glimmer of will left in her eyes.

She was many times stronger than before her behavior had changedー
but still, we had a plan on how to deal with her.
Yukikaze, with her lightning guns in hand, boldly commenced the attack.
The shield that Clear was holding glowed faintly and easily blocked the supposedly powerful lightning projectiles.
But that was also part of the plan.
Good, Yukikaze!! Keep shooting like that and restrict her movement!!
Upon seeing my hand signal, Hebiko jumped from the wall of a building she had stuck to with her suckers, raised her octopus leg and unleashed a... punch(?).
Hastily, Clear fought off Hebiko with her blade.
But her move wasn't sharp enough.
Clear's blade stopped about halfway through Hebiko's self-regenerating octopus tentacle.
Ughh, owowowow... But Hebiko stopped her blade! Shikanosuke-chan!!
Y-Yeah!! I-I'm gonna do my best!!
Shikanosuke approached Clear, who had both of her hands occupied, from behind.

Fuma, this device on her head, right!? Hyaaー
Electric Jutsu: Spark!!!
Clear's body shook violently. But only for a moment.
The blade and shield in her hands disappeared with a mechanical whirr.
Clear collapsed on the spot like a puppet whose strings had been cut.
I rushed over to Clear and hurriedly helped her up.
Shikanosuke's Spark was weak and had basically no killing power.
But Clear's face was pale and her breathing was weak and irregular, perhaps because the electricity had flown directly into the device connected to her head.
What the hell is going on!? Who are you...!?
I asked, and Clear looked up at me with vacant eyes.
I am sorry... I did... a bad thing... But... it was... a mission...
The light had slightly returned to Clear's eyes.
She had the same innocent, child-like expression on her face as when we had eaten ice cream together at Inageya...
Uhh... ice cream... tasty... playing... fun... again... together...
Clear mumbled in fragments, and suddenly her body went limp.
Yukikaze came closer and asked me, but I didn't know either.
We had met by coincidence... but I somehow hadn't been able to just leave her be.
Fuma-chan, let's bring her to the infirmary for now. And we have to contact Asagi-sensei too.
As I lifted up Clear to carry her to the infirmaryー
Ah, wait a second!! Shikanosuke, figure out the status of the device's receiver!!
Eh!? Fuma, what is it, all of a suddenー
I directed Shikanosuke to the device attached to Clear's head.

The device should have been destroyed by the flowing electricityー
but it was now blinking ominously.
It's not over yet!! Whoever is controlling Clear is trying something again!!
Most likely to destroy any evidence. And for the complete execution of her missionー
Clear had said that she had to deliver something inside her belly to Asagi-sensei.
What if it was a bomb that could be controlled remotelyー?
Now that Clear had failed and had been taken down like this...
...it wouldn't be unnatural for them to blow everything away, aiming to conceal the evidence and destroy Gosha Academy.
Ahh!? There's definitely something coming!! Fuma, some nasty radio waves are being transmitted to her!!
Ughー!? Shikanosuke, trace the source of that signal!!
Even if Shikanosuke was able to trace the source, Clear and the academy would most likely already be blown up by then.
Yukikaze!! Shoot into the air with everything you've got!!
Yeah!! These waves are most likely the signal for a remote detonator! But your lightning will buy us some time!! It's an electromagnetic wave!!
With the electromagnetic waves that occurred when Yukikaze used her powerful lightning attacks, we might be able to interfere with the signal going to Clear.
Yukikaze swallowed hard and readied her lightning guns.
I want you to shoot at full blast!! You still have quite a bit left in the tank, don't you!?
I nodded at Yukikaze with a smile.
Maybe Yukikaze also hadn't really wanted to kill Clear, or maybe she had been worried about the fallen Taimanin all around us.
In any event, it should have been the case that Yukikaze still had quite a bit more power in her.
If Yukikaze had fought with all her strength, even Clear would have had trouble reflecting all of her lightning projectiles with the shield.
Ahaha, I guess even you were able to notice, Fuma!! Full blast, got it!!
Yukikaze laughed and aimed her lightning guns at the sky.
She shot a lightning projectile with maximum power into the skyー
The air trembled and a vortex swirled. Then the device on Clear's head reacted erratically with a crackle.
But Fuma, I can't keep shooting forever!!!

I know!!!ー
Shikanosuke, did you find the source!?
Y-Yeah!! Only roughly though... this way!!
Sensing my intentions, Shikanosuke and Hebiko ran out of the academy.
And I also ran after them.
I could see a group of dependable Taimanin led by Asagi-sensei coming from the academy building after they had heard the commotion.
Now there was no need to worry anymore.
This "incident on my day off" that I had unexpectedly gotten involved in was rapidly coming to a close.
After class that day, I had come to the headmistress's office.
It was about Clear's case, which I had asked Asagi-sensei to handle in the aftermath.
Well then, I'll briefly explain what I have found out about her.
As I had guessed, Clear was not a normal human.
But she was also not a Taimanin or demon.
Apparently she was an augmented human created by a secret agency within the government.
Yes. Her code name is "Type: HERO."

She was originally created to fight against evilー
but it seems that someone stole her.
In fact, this case was the reason why I had been called to meet with the government officials.
They had asked for my cooperation in the search for her... but who would've expected that she would be coming after me.
Asagi-sensei gave an exasperated wry smile.
Did whoever stole Clear give her the orders?
Not only had Clear been made to attack Gosha Academy by herself, she had also had a bomb planted inside her stomach.
If the attack had failed, the cruel plan had been to blow up Clear along with the bomb.
We had chased after whoever had been controlling Clear with the help of Shikanosuke's radar detection, but in the end they had already fled.
Yes, probably. But the investigation into that scoundrel is ongoing.
We have some guesses about who it might be, since they had a variety of information regarding Gosha... but I cannot say anything yet.
She also seems to know nothing about whoever had been controlling her...
When I made a gloomy face, Asagi-sensei smiled as if telling me not to worry.
But I also have some good news. Kiryu disarmed the bomb that was planted in her.
Kiryu was a shady demonologist who dwelled in the underground laboratory of the academy.
He was a hell of a guy in a lot of different ways, but his skills in the field of Devildomian medicine alone were top-notch.
Yes. And with that she is officially free to go.
That's good to hear... So what will happen to her now...?
Would she be returned to the government laboratory?
In that case, we would most likely never see each other again...
Haha. Of course, I arranged for her to be placed in Gosha's care.
It's only natural, isn't it? A girl with that much power, someone else might try to get their hands on her again.
Then where would she be living? With Asagi-sensei?
That's why I asked Yukikaze to take care of her.
Haha. What? Did you want to live with her?
Hmm. Would someone like Yukikaze be able to look after Clear...?
In fact, she also wanted to go with you.
But if the worst case happened again, only someone as powerful as Yukikaze would be able to stop her.
If you thought about it like that, Yukikaze might be surprisingly well-suited for the job.
Yukikaze is also living alone right now, so I think it will work out perfectly.
For some reason she also seems to be vigilant about Yukikaze.
As I tilted my head, Asagi-sensei called out in the direction of a door at the back of the room.

Haha. Hear the details directly from herー
Come in, Clear.
The door at the back of the headmistress's office opened and from thereー
I hadn't seen Clear in quite some time.
Her wounds were completely healed and she had a big smile on her face, just like when we had played with the frisbee.
Guess what? I... can stay... in the village.
Yeah, I heard that. Good for you!!
Clear was an augmented human created for combat.
It might not end up being the peaceful life of a regular person right away...
But at least as long as she was in this village, she wouldn't be exploited by any weirdos.
I'm going to leave the rest to you, Fuma-kun.
A new mission for the captain of the Independent Commando Unit. Bring her to Yukikaze's homeーand show her around the village on the way.
Asagi-sensei smiled and saw us out of her office.
Th-This is a mission...? Oh well, I guess I have no choice.
I gave a strained chuckle and looked at Clear.
I wasn't sure what was so amusing, but Clear looked up at me while smiling ear to ear.
Will you be alright though? At Yukikaze's house?
That girl... is bad. She can't... be friendly with Fuma.
Huh? It's more like she and I fight like cats and dogs...
I didn't really get it, but this didn't seem like something she'd give up on.
So, what do you want to do? Do you want to get something to eat before we go to Yukikaze's house?
I didn't have much money as usual, but just for today, I guess I could buy her something again.
Clear looked up at me and said with a smile.
Inageya! I... want to eat ice cream!
